content.short: Forj, formerly Bondly Finance, is an Animoca Brands company behind the first official Ethereum-to-Cardano NFT bridge.
content.description: Bondly Finance is now Forj, following a strategic rebrand announced in May 2022. Majority owned by Animoca Brands, the company focuses on onboarding mass audiences to Web3 and NFT technology across music, sports, lifestyle, celebrity brands, and gaming, with a stated mission of deepening the relationship between creators and their fans. Its Cardano relevance comes from building the first official Ethereum-to-Cardano NFT bridge in collaboration with Input Output (IOHK). Earlier work under the Bondly name included creator NFT drops and the Mint-on-Demand minting platform.
